gaps.sentence: When the alarm sounded, everyone made ___ the nearest exit.
gaps.explanation: 'Make for' = move towards, usually in haste.

gaps.sentence: They've set ___ a new charity for homeless dogs.
The talks fell ___ when neither side would compromise on fishing rights.
gaps.explanation: 'Fall through' = (a plan or deal) fail to be completed.

gaps.sentence: The plane takes ___ in ten minutes.
gaps.explanation: take off = leave the ground (plane); also remove clothes; become successful (career took off).

gaps.sentence: The subject cropped ___ again at dinner.
gaps.explanation: crop up = appear or happen unexpectedly.

gaps.sentence: The plane will drop ___ the parcels at the next farm.
gaps.explanation: drop off = deliver somebody/something; also become less (sales dropped off).

gaps.sentence: It took him weeks to get ___ the flu.
gaps.explanation: get over an illness/upset = recover from it.

gaps.sentence: Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
